verdict.rationale: Proa documents compile-time-checked props on typed Rust components, plus editor hover and completion inside templates, so prop typing is checked by the toolchain. Nothing shows typing for emitted events or event handlers, and nothing shows that prop types are inferred without the developer writing type definitions. missing for 10: typed/inferred emitted events, evidence that prop types are inferred without explicit annotations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
